spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (खचति) also r. 9th cl. (खन्नाति)
1 To be past birth.
2 To cause prosperity.
3 To purify.
r. 10th cl. (खचयति)
To fasten, to bind, to set.

m. (-सः)
The moon.
E.
ख the sky, चम to eat, and अस aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Moving in the sky, flying in the air.
m. (-रः)
1 A cloud.
2 An aerial spirit.
3 Air, wind.
4 A demon.
5 The sun.
6 A bird.
E.
ख the sky, and चर who goes, from चर to go, affix ट; see also खेचर.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Mixed, blended, inlaid.
2 Joined, combined.
E.
खच to fasten, &c. affix क्त.
